title: Trust Administrator
description:
Location: Beaminster

Salary £27k-£32k DOE (will pay more for experienced Trust administrator)

Hours: 9am-5.30pm Mon-Thurs, 9am-5pm Fri

Benefits: 25 days hols + Bank hols (including 3 for Christmas shutdown), birthday off, no onsite parking but provide car parking permit for local car park, pension, medical insurance after probation, social events during the year

Aspire Jobs are delighted to be working in an exclusive partnership with our professional services client who are a well-established and growing firm based in West Dorset. They are seeking to recruit a Trust Administrator to join their busy team. This is a perfect time to join a growing and progressive thinking team and firm.

Are you an organised administrator with excellent attention to detail? Do you enjoy working with figures, managing accurate records and being part of a professional team?

Perhaps you already have experience within legal services, finance or trust administration or from within a professional services firm. Or maybe you're looking for the opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in a highly regarded firm where full training will be provided.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established Trusts department in a varied role offering long-term career development.

The Role

Working as part of a busy and supportive team, you'll help administer a portfolio of trusts, ensuring everything is managed accurately, efficiently and in line with legal requirements.

No two days are quite the same and you'll be involved in a wide range of administrative and financial tasks. As this is a new role you will be setting up systems and spreadsheets from scratch so a real chance to make the role your own.

Responsibilities will include:
- Assisting with the administration of trusts
- Maintaining accurate records and documentation
- Processing financial transactions
- Preparing trust accounts and supporting financial administration
- Liaising with clients and professional advisers
- Ensuring deadlines are met and files remain compliant
- Providing general administrative support to the Trusts team

About You

We're much more interested in finding the right person than someone with previous trust experience.

You'll probably have:
- Previous administration experience
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good numerical ability and confidence working with figures
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- A methodical approach to your work
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office particularly Excel

Experience within a legal practice, financial services, accountancy or trust administration would be an advantage but is by no means essential, as full training will be provided.

title: HR Administrator
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Temporary assignment to cover long term sickness - Poole - Hybrid (2 days office)
£16.50 / £17.00 an hour DOE

Are you an organised HR professional with recruitment experience and a passion for delivering an excellent candidate experience? We're looking for a proactive HR & Recruitment Administrator/Coordinator to support a busy HR team across the full employee lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage end-to-end recruitment processes using an Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ideally IRIS Networx.
- Create engaging job adverts and utilise social media to attract top talent.
- Process pre-employment checks including DBS, Right to Work and reference requests.
- Support visa sponsorship applications and ensure compliance with immigration requirements.
- Maintain accurate employee records and support data migration/testing within a new HR system.
- Manage the HR inbox, responding to recruitment and HR-related queries efficiently.
- Provide administrative support to managers throughout the recruitment and onboarding process.
- Assist with HR meetings and occasionally take notes during employee relations hearings.

About You:
- Previous experience in a HR or Recruitment Administration/Coordinator role.
- Strong understanding of recruitment processes and pre-employment screening requirements.
- Knowledge of sponsorship processes and Right to Work legislation.
- Good understanding of employment law and HR best practice.
- Excellent organisation, time management and communication skills.
- Confident managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience using HR systems and applicant tracking systems.

What's on Offer?
- Varied and busy role within a supportive HR team.
- Opportunity to be involved in recruitment, HR systems and employee relations.
- Excellent environment for someone looking to broaden their HR experience and develop their career.

This role would suit an HR Administrator, HR Coordinator, Recruitment Coordinator or Recruitment Administrator looking for their next challenge.

What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

- Proactive and methodical approach

title: Customer Operations Coordinator
description:
Customer Operations Coordinator

Location: Bournemouth
Salary: 28,000 to 31,000 per annum
Job Type: Full Time Permanent

About the Role

TeamJobs are recruiting for a Customer Service Executive to join a well established and growing business based in Bournemouth.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys delivering exceptional customer service in a fast paced environment. You'll be responsible for supporting customers throughout their journey, managing enquiries, coordinating appointments and working closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.

Benefits
- 28,000 to 31,000 per annum
- 33 days annual leave including Bank Holidays
- Company pension
- Company sick pay
- Career development and progression opportunities
- Employee referral programme
- Performance related salary reviews
- Company events and team socials
- Free flu jabs
- Eye care vouchers
- Monday to Friday working
- Modern office environment

The Role

As a Customer Service Executive, you will be the main point of contact for customers, ensuring they receive a first class service from enquiry through to resolution. You'll liaise with customers, engineers and internal teams to coordinate appointments, resolve issues and keep customers informed every step of the way.

Key Responsibilities
- Respond to customer enquiries via telephone and email.
- Deliver a professional and friendly customer experience.
- Coordinate appointments and schedule engineers where required.
- Manage customer cases from enquiry through to resolution.
- Keep customers updated throughout the process.
- Liaise with internal departments to resolve queries efficiently.
- Support customers with technical and operational enquiries.
- Build strong relationships with customers and contractors.
- Maintain accurate records using the company's CRM system.

About You

We're looking for someone who has:
- At least two years' experience within a customer service, customer support or operations role.
- Excellent communication and telephone skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- A proactive approach to problem solving.
- The ability to remain calm and professional in a busy environment.
- A positive, team focused attitude.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office, and confidence using CRM systems.

Apply Today

If you're looking to join a growing business where you can develop your career and make a real difference to the customer experience, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact TeamJobs for more information.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator - Christchurch - £14.88 per hour

You'll be the calm, dependable point of contact between customers and the wider team.
Every order that comes through your inbox gets handled with care, from first check to final confirmation.

As a Sales Administrator, you will benefit from:
- An early finish every Friday, wrapping up at 3:45pm
- A discretionary yearly bonus, rewarding your contribution
- A TOIL policy that recognises time given beyond your usual hours
- Free on site parking

- Receive and process customer orders accurately via email, telephone and online systems
- Check orders against quotations, pricing and product availability before processing
- Enter sales orders onto the company system, ensuring all details are correct

As a Sales Administrator, your experience will include:
- Proven experience in a customer service, order processing or administrative role
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when handling order information
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple orders and priorities
- Confident communication skills and a professional telephone manner
- Good IT skills, including experience using order processing, CRM or ERP systems

If you're ready to bring your accuracy and reliability to a Sales Administrator role where you're genuinely valued, we want to hear from you. Apply today with an up-to-date CV or call Claire at Rubicon for more information.

While Rubicon uses AI to help speed up processes across the business, every application is reviewed by a human to ensure the right decision is made.

title: Claims Handler - Home / Motor / Insurance - Remote
description:
Technical Claims Handler / Claim Handler / General Insurance / Motor / Home / GI / CII / ACCI / Remote / UK / United Kingdom (Must have full RTW in the UK without sponsorship)

£25,000 - £60,000 + Bonus + Excellent Benefits Fully Remote

(Multiple levels/roles available - salary depending on experience)

We're working with an established and growing General Insurance business that is looking to appoint a Technical Claims Handler to join its team on a fully remote basis.

This is an excellent opportunity for a claims professional with a background in Motor and/or Home Insurance who is looking to take on a more technical role, dealing with complex claims and having greater ownership over decisions and outcomes.

The Role

You'll be responsible for managing a portfolio of technically complex claims from initial notification through to resolution, using your experience and technical knowledge to assess coverage, liability and indemnity and determine the appropriate course of action.

You'll deal with a range of stakeholders including customers, brokers, insurers, loss adjusters, solicitors and other third parties, ensuring claims are handled fairly, efficiently and in line with policy terms and regulatory requirements.

The role will include:
- Managing Motor and Home claims.
- Reviewing policy wordings and assessing coverage, liability and indemnity.
- Investigating claims and reviewing supporting evidence.
- Making technically sound decisions on settlement and claims strategy.
- Negotiating with customers and third parties where required.
- Identifying potential fraud, exaggeration or inconsistencies.
- Managing disputed and escalated claims.
- Supporting colleagues with technical claims queries.
- Ensuring FCA, regulatory and internal requirements are consistently met.
- Maintaining accurate claims records and documentation.

About You

We're looking for someone with General Insurance claims experience who is comfortable dealing with technically challenging cases and making decisions independently.

You'll ideally have experience across Motor or Home claims, although broader General Insurance experience will also be considered.

You'll need to be confident interpreting policy wordings, investigating claims, assessing liability and negotiating appropriate settlements. Just as importantly, you'll be commercially minded, customer-focused and comfortable working autonomously in a remote environment.

CII / ACII qualifications or progress towards them would be advantageous.

What's In It For You?
- £25,000 - £60,000 salary, depending on experience
- Annual bonus
- 100% remote working
- Excellent benefits package
- Generous annual leave
- Pension
- Life assurance
- Professional development and training
- Support towards relevant insurance qualifications
- Genuine long-term career progression
- The opportunity to join a growing insurance business where your technical expertise will be valued

If you're an experienced Technical Claims Handler looking for a genuinely flexible, fully remote opportunity with a strong salary and excellent benefits, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Claims Handler
description:
- Do you have Claims Handling experience?
- Do you enjoy working in a team environment and would like to work in an office?
- Are you looking to work for a company who are expanding and growing offering opportunities to progress?
- Would you like to learn a different area of the Claims Sector where full training and support will be provided?
- Worried about parking costs? - free parking is provided
- Travel? - located very close to transport links and if local to Poole/Bournemouth journey time will be minimal!

An experienced Claims Handler is required to join a specialist Marine Claims Management Practice who work closely with the Lloyd's of London market, as well as MGA's, Brokers and Retail Agents throughout the UK managing specialist claims covering a wide range of water vessels including paddle boards, jet ski's, narrowboats, yachts etc.

This will be an exciting time to join due to expansion and new clients coming on board offering career progression and development long-term and being part of their growth.

Key responsibilities:
- Working in a team environment.
- Managing Marine claims cradle to grave overseeing the lifecycle of the claim, Marine claims experience isn't essential as full training and support will be provided
- Being a focal point for key clients including the Lloyds of London market
- Gathering and assessing evidence, checking policy wordings and establishing validity
- Calculating quantum and negotiating settlements up to circa £2m

About you:
- An experienced Claims handler within the Insurance Claims Industry, from a Broking, Insurer or Adjusting environment
- A background in handling claims, being able to interpret policy wordings and establishing validity
- An exceptional communicator verbal and written
- Enjoy working in a team environment as well as being able to work on own initiative
- Be happy to work in an office environment full-time although my client does offer some flexibility should the need to work from home arise
- Have a passion or be interested in sailing or water sports - desirable
- Industry qualifications - ideally, working towards or would like to work towards

Office hours - Monday to Friday 9am-5pm with an hour for lunch with the option to leave early on a Friday, 20 days holiday plus bank holidays with a Birthday day holiday, free parking.

title: Administrator
description: Regents Park Healthcare are looking for an Administrator to work within the administration team at the Dorset Heart Clinic. The right candidate should have 2 years administration experience ideally within NHS or other healthcare settings, strong IT skills and have an outgoing and friendly attitude. The work can be highly demanding, therefore, the ability to prioritise your own workload and meet deadlines is also essential. JOB TITLE: Administrator REPORTS TO: Clinic Manager LOCATION: Dorset Heart Clinic, Bournemouth, UK HOURS: Working patterns are assigned across Monday to Sat, typically covering 8am - 8pm with full-time hours equating to 37.5 per week. We expect there will be no requirement to work Bank Holidays without prior & mutual agreement. SALARY: From £25,685.00/year, depending on experience. JOB TYPE: Full-time, Permanent BENEFITS: Company events Company pension contributions Health & wellbeing programme On-site parking Private medical insurance Generous Sick pay Life Cover 25 days holiday + bank holidays RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES To liaise effectively and efficiently with (but not limited to) the following individuals/organisations: Consultants and their secretaries. Patients and their relatives. Referring GPs and their offices. Private medical insurance companies. Clinical staff. NHS Trust staff. Self-Payers; and Other third-party organisations. To manage correspondence and telephone enquiries speedily and accurately. To book outpatients appointments onto IT systems. To prepare medical notes and other clinical information in preparation for a clinical session, ensuring all paperwork is filed correctly and no notes are missing. To ensure all payments for self-payers are collected on the same day as their clinic visit wherever possible. To type letters and other correspondence accurately and swiftly. To ensure a log of any payments received is completed on a weekly basis and updated on the appropriate management systems. To provide clinic receptionist duties if required to do so. To maintain inventory of supplies. To collaborate closely with medical staff, department heads, and other administrators to support effective communication, collaboration, and problem-solving. To undertake mandatory training relevant to the role to remain compliant with our ways of working. Any other duties that may be required consistent with the nature and grade of the post.

title: Receptionist/Administrator
company: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
description: You have an opportunity to join the Outpatient Reception and Administration team at Yeatman Hospital.We are a small friendly unit of dedicated staff working to support the local Community Hospital services and a wide range of clinics from Yeovil and Dorset County Hospital. The post will require a positive, flexible and proactive approach to cover a busy reception together with associated administrative procedures and responsibilities as detailed in the attached Job Description. Please note visa sponsorship for this role is unfortunately not available. Ensure you hold valid right to work in the UK and will not require sponsorship if successful. Employment in this post requires a Standard Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check, which the Trust will cover the cost of. The main duties will be covering Main Reception desk, making and changing patient appointments, outcoming clinics, maintaining office supplies via e-procurement systems, dealing with patient enquiries in person and by telephone, processing clinic change notifications as directed by line manager. Assisting the team by sharing skills and knowledge with colleagues to maintain best practice. For the main duties and responsibilities for this role please read the attached job description and person specification. When completing your application please ensure your supporting statement reflects the criteria set out in these documents by showing how your experience and skills apply to this post. We understand that AI can be a useful tool when completing your application. However, we are seeing an increasing over-reliance of AI tools, which can negatively affect your application as it reduces a candidates individuality, and makes it difficult for us to gain a clear and authentic understanding of your experience, skills, and in turn your suitability for the role. All submissions must be truthful and if you do use AI, it should only be used to enhance your application and not create your supporting statement in its entirety. Your supporting statement should be in your own words and must accurately reflect your personal experience and achievements. Where we have concerns that AI has been used to generate content that misrepresents your experience and suitability for the role, we may withdraw your application. As part of our vision to have a skilled, diverse and caring workforce, Dorset HealthCare offers support for people getting into work. We offer an employability service to support individuals with application writing, interview skills and other employment support. If you would like or know of anyone who would value this support, please do contactdhc.wideningparticipation@nhs.net
